objective: Use the current workspace and checkout by default without implicit branch changes or isolated clones
acceptance_criteria: Read-only inspection reports detached HEAD and current Git operations without mutation
New pinned tasks run in the current dirty or detached checkout without fetch/update/branch changes
Exact sync preserves current branch association and non-overlapping local edits
Old jobs keep original semantics and cannot be replayed by changing mode
Shared skill and tool guidance require explicit user choice for branch or isolated development
Regression tests, deployment and actual read-only evidence are distinguished and pushed
